618: def parse_texts():
619:     text_blocks = {}

623:     ]:

627:             cur_labels = []
628:             cur_paras = []
629:             cur_lines = []
630:             for l in content.splitlines():
631:                 m = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z0-9_]+)::?$", l.strip())
632:                 if m:
633:                     if (cur_paras or cur_lines) and cur_labels:
634:                         if cur_lines:
635:                             cur_paras.append(" ".join(cur_lines))
636:                         txt = "\n\n".join(cur_paras).strip()
637:                         for lb in cur_labels:
638:                             text_blocks[lb] = txt
639:                         cur_labels = []
640:                         cur_paras = []
641:                         cur_lines = []
642:                     cur_labels.append(m.group(1))
643:                 else:
644:                     tm = re.match(
645:                         r'^\s*(text|line|next|para|cont)\s+"([^"]*)"', l
646:                     )
647:                     if tm:
648:                         kind, raw = tm.groups()
649:                         s = clean_poke_str(raw)
650:                         if kind == "para" and cur_lines:
651:                             cur_paras.append(" ".join(cur_lines))
652:                             cur_lines = [s]
653:                         else:
654:                             cur_lines.append(s)
655:             if (cur_paras or cur_lines) and cur_labels:
656:                 if cur_lines:
657:                     cur_paras.append(" ".join(cur_lines))
658:                 txt = "\n\n".join(cur_paras).strip()
659:                 for lb in cur_labels:
660:                     text_blocks[lb] = txt
661: 
662:     # Parse all global label sections across all scripts/*.asm (including *_2.asm!)
663:     global_sections = {}
664:     trainer_headers = {}
665:     tconst_to_hlabel = {}
666: 
667:     for p in sorted(glob.glob(f"{POKEYELLOW}/scripts/*.asm")):
668:         with open(p) as f:
669:             st = strip_debug(f.read())
670:         for hlabel, tconst in re.findall(
671:             r"dw_const\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+),\s*(TEXT_[A-Z0-9_]+)", st
672:         ):
673:             tconst_to_hlabel[tconst] = hlabel
674: 
675:         for tm in re.finditer(
676:             r"([A-Za-z0-9_]+):\s*\n\s*trainer\s+[^,]+,\s*[^,]+,\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+),\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+),\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)",
677:             st,
678:         ):
679:             th_lbl, b_lbl, e_lbl, a_lbl = tm.groups()
680:             trainer_headers[th_lbl] = (b_lbl, e_lbl, a_lbl)
681: 
682:         lines = st.splitlines()
683:         cur_lbls = []
684:         cur_body = []
685:         for line in lines:
686:             m = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z0-9_]+)::?$", line.strip())
687:             if m:
688:                 if cur_body and cur_lbls:
689:                     body_str = "\n".join(cur_body)
690:                     for lb in cur_lbls:
691:                         global_sections[lb] = body_str
692:                     cur_lbls = []
693:                     cur_body = []
694:                 cur_lbls.append(m.group(1))
695:             else:
696:                 cur_body.append(line)
697:         if cur_body and cur_lbls:
698:             body_str = "\n".join(cur_body)
699:             for lb in cur_lbls:
700:                 global_sections[lb] = body_str
701: 
702:     def resolve_label_list(lbl, depth=0):
703:         if depth > 4 or not lbl:
704:             return []
705:         if "_" + lbl in text_blocks:
706:             return [text_blocks["_" + lbl]]
707:         if lbl in text_blocks:
708:             return [text_blocks[lbl]]
709:         sec = global_sections.get(lbl, "")
710:         if not sec:
711:             return []
712:         out = []
713:         for tf in re.findall(r"text_far\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)", sec):
714:             if tf in text_blocks and text_blocks[tf] not in out:
715:                 out.append(text_blocks[tf])
716:         refs = re.findall(r"(?:farcall|call|jp|ld\s+hl,|ld\s+de,)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)", sec)
717:         for r in refs:
718:             if r in (
719:                 "PrintText",
720:                 "TextScriptEnd",
721:                 "TalkToTrainer",
722:                 "DisplayTextID",
723:                 "YesNoChoice",
724:                 "GiveItem",
725:                 "SaveEndBattleTextPointers",
726:                 "EngageMapTrainer",
727:                 "InitBattleEnemyParameters",
728:             ):
729:                 continue
730:             if r in trainer_headers:
731:                 b_lbl, e_lbl, a_lbl = trainer_headers[r]
732:                 for sub_l in (b_lbl, e_lbl, a_lbl):
733:                     for s in resolve_label_list(sub_l, depth + 1):
734:                         if s not in out:
735:                             out.append(s)
736:                 continue
737:             for s in resolve_label_list(r, depth + 1):
738:                 if s not in out:
739:                     out.append(s)
740:         return out
741: 
742:     text_const_to_info = {}
743:     for tconst, hlabel in tconst_to_hlabel.items():
744:         sec = global_sections.get(hlabel, "")
745:         # Check if this handler points to a TrainerHeader
746:         th_match = re.search(r"ld\s+hl,\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+TrainerHeader[A-Za-z0-9_]*)", sec)
